nom: Philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker Fix Eye Power-Treatment Fill & Firm

avis.titre: Philosophy takes good care of my skin!
avis.texte: I love this product. I've been using it for years. The skin under my eyes looks very smooth and nice.
It pills/rolls up under makeup. The Hydro bounce for eyes was the absolute best eye cream for under makeup. Why keep this one and discontinue the better product?
This is the best eye cream I've used yet! I'm in my late 30's and needed an eye cream that's more potent than drugstore buys. Only a small amount of product on each eye is needed.

avis.titre: The perfect treatment for a more youthful, hydra
avis.texte: "I am genuinely impressed with this eye serum! After consistent use, the delicate skin around my eyes feels much firmer and looks noticeably smoother. It has a 'filling' effect that helps soften fine lines, making my under-eye area look refreshed and more youthful. The texture is lightweight and absorbs beautifully. Highly recommend
I haven't seen any changes, but I've only been using it for a short time. I do like that it feels very light and not sticky. Moisturizer too.
I love this product. Great for sensitive skin! I use it twice a day. Good for under concealer
I'm liking it so far. Haven't been using the product long but can see the difference.

The pump doesn't work well consistently. I have purchased a few of these over a period of time and none of them work well. Sometimes they will pump out the moisturizer and sometimes nothing will come out. I have to work and work to get it to pump the product. This was much better when it came in the little jars. I hope you will reconsider the jars and go back to that method.

avis.titre: Brighter, Smoother Eyes with Philosophy Ultimate M
avis.texte: I've been using the Philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker Fix Serum Eye Power Treatment consistently, and I'm very impressed with the results. The packaging is sleek, hygienic, and easy to use, making it perfect for daily application. The serum has a very light, clean aroma that isn't overpowering at all, which I really appreciate around the eye area. The texture is silky and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. I noticed my under-eye area looks smoother, more hydrated, and brighter over time, with no irritation or skin reaction at all—even on my sensitive skin. A little goes a long way, so the product lasts a long time, making it feel like a great value. Overall, this eye treatment feels gentle yet effective, and it fits perfectly into my skincare routine.
It reduces puffiness and fine lines ,dark circles that hydrate under makeup . It leaves the under eye looking brighter which works well and doesn't cause piling and can last for several months
It was just okay. It felt nice, but even with continuous use, I saw no difference when I got to the end of the container. Overall, the texture was nice and it felt hydrating on my skin.
A drop of serum and a few taps around my eyes, and I've watched the wrinkles melt away and the creases ease into smoothness more with every day.

I hardly ever return products, but this had to go back!! It was too pricey to burn my eyes 2 times and had me not be able to wear any eye products when I went to the gym because of the extreme irritation. My undereye got sooo sensitive!! I would not recommend this product at all!! I usually have no problems with eye creams and I've tried dozens over my lifetime.
This stuff is amazing for people whose undereyes are sensitive to thicker products. As it's a serum, it's super lightweight, but gets the job done by firming and moisturizing the under eyes.
Love everything about this product! I've been using this brand for years. It makes my skin glow and great for dry skin. The texture is very light. Buy this you won't regret it!

This works..I been using this product for the first time..It does fill in the areas as I aged to smooth out the hollow that I recently noticed ..needed attentio. This does help to fill in ..Because I am older ..I would definetly recomend this eye cream Philosophy..Thank you!
Love the feel and results, been using about 3 weeks and this is my new eye cream!

I bought this as a present for myself on my birthday. I am in my late 30s. I was recommended this by an Ulta staff for under eye line treatment and general prevention. I used it once a day at night for a week before I had to space it out because it burned. Then I had to stop a while before resuming. Finally, I quit altogether when my under eyes got so dry, dark, and creppy. I had to buy something else to treat the damage this caused. Perhaps my under eye skin is too thin or sensitive.

avis.titre: Package in tube instead of pump containter
avis.texte: I was a BIG fan of Hope in Tube because I could cut the tube when the product stopped squeezing out - that way I was able to get every drop of product. With the pump container I think a lot of product is left in the container once the product stops pumping out. There's no way to cut the container. The product is expensive so I would like to get the most for my money

This eye cream caused swelling and redness around my upper eyelids, more prominent on the right eye. Agter ising the cream as suggested, my eye lids felt like they were burning. The skin abobe my eyes appeared slightly raised and shiny, suggesting inflammation or fluid retention.

avis.titre: Pills when you use under eye concealer
avis.texte: I loved hope in a tube and can not understand why it was discontinued. Concealer glided right over it. Unfortunately this product pills terribly. I wont buy sgain!
BRING BACK HOPE IN A TUBE! None of your other eye creams work including this one

avis.titre: Lovely, hydrating serum that glides on
avis.texte: I love using this in the mornings to give my under-eye area a little pick-me-up. As a new mom who doesn't often get the best quality sleep, this serum makes me look just a little bit fresher and ready to take on the day. It glides on smoothly and keeps my skin hydrated.
Clean scent, nice packaging, as far as effectiveness I don't know that I really noticed anything that was a drastic change. It was a nice texture. It absorbed nicely.
It pills no matter what I do or don't do. It will pill on bare skin with nothing on top.

avis.titre: It only takes a very small amount of product to se
avis.texte: Received this product from Influencer. It doesn't take much to hydrate and smooth eyes with this product. It has a very mild scent, and is very gentle on sensitive skin. The container is small but the effect is mighty. After using this product for several weeks, I found it improved the fine lines around my eyes only a little. I believe if I were to continue using the product, it will improve the fine lines even more. Overall, I think this is a great product.

I have tried various eye creams. I thought I would give this one by philosophy, a shot. quite pricey. But I got a good deal last Christmas at Ulta so I gave it a shot. I think after using it for about a month it less than the small lines around my eyes and underneath of them and I have been using it ever since. No irritation or smell l. And you don't have to use very much. I would recommend it.
Best result for under eyes circles, I am very happy with the result I will be purchasing this product again. I wish it was a bigger bottle, other than that I am happy with my product.
This firms and fills my undereye so much. It has made a dramatic improvement in my eye area. No irritation at all and fast absorption.

All I can really say is WOW! From the very first use my eye area was so much firmer and fine lines were gone. It was a dramatic difference right away and each use seems to make it even better. No scent and no eye irritation at all. It only takes a tiny drop to do both eyes so even though it's a small tube it'll last a long time.

As a busy mom, I'm always looking for products that deliver real results, and this eye power-treatment is a game-changer! After just a few weeks, I noticed my under-eye area looking smoother and more refreshed. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and works perfectly under makeup. My skin feels firmer, and I can see the difference every morning. This truly lives up to its name—thank you, Philosophy, for this little miracle! Would highly recommend it to anyone looking for an eye treatment that really works.

avis.titre: Easy to apply and very lightweight formula
avis.texte: I was really impressed with this serum. It went on without any greasiness and I really love the applicator tip. It makes it super easy to apply. Very lightweight and great packaging too!
I like this product….but, It does not offer enough moisturization to my surrounding eye tissue.

I was impressed with this serum. It goes on smoothly and leaves no greasy residue. There is no smell and the texture is light. No chemical smell and the packaging is beautiful as usual. Will buy again.
I like it, it's smooth and non sticky. But I do not see a big difference.
Good quality ingredients, Package is very pretty. The texture is smooth and the scent is good. But most of all it is very Effective. I am 54 and really don't look like it.

avis.titre: Best eye cream I've tried in awhile
avis.texte: This eye cream is excellent. It is a heavier cream that I wouldn't recommend for day time use for those with oily skin. It is super moisturizing and seems to visibly lessen fine line around the eyes as soon as it is applied. Over about a 6 week period of time I could tell a difference. It has no scent that I can determine and the packaging is quite handy to use.

Love this! I have been using it for barely 30 days and my mother pointed out a difference in my dark circles and puffiness due to postpartum exhaustion and I took a minute to look at myself and it was amazing!

avis.titre: It actually does what it promises
avis.texte: I have a drawer loaded with eye products. Some work a little and some don't work at all. I am truly amazed to watch my crows' feet fading away with this product. I do recommend this to other senior ladies hoping to iron out their wrinkles.
This was suggested by a sales associate and I am so impressed. It is as wonderful as he conveyed with results noted
I went to buy a different eye concealer. The ladies introduced me to these products & I absolutely love them! I gave away my previous used products.

avis.titre: A non greasy winner, that lives up to its descrip
avis.texte: This eye cream is wonderful & definitely does the job! Having the sun screen in it makes it a plus!

avis.titre: Reduces eye puffiness and dark circles.
avis.texte: I have dark circles and puffy eyes. This product was noticeable both immediately and after several days. It was effective and valid in the product claims. would keep using the product for more long-term effects.
I don't see any visible difference. My eyes look and feel the same.

This product is expensive, it promises a lot and it doesn't really do anything, at first it leaves you with very nice dark circles, it seems as if you had a filter, you look fabulous, but when the effect wears off you are left with more dark circles and bags under your eyes. They look flabby, also during the day without waiting much it starts to peel off as if you were shedding your skin and that's the trick, that thin layer that makes your eyes look beautiful is just a curtain of lies, the effect doesn't last even two hours. and how much it costs, I definitely won't buy it again

Wow - what a fabulous product - I love it and have bought more already! Makes eyes perked a and very soft - gentle around eyes absorbs right into my skin! Scent is mellow - the bottle is shaped perfects for woman's hands

I've been using this product for about a month. I have seen a difference especially around the laugh lines at corners of eye. I will continue to use to see if it even gets better. No fragrance and no problems using it so close to eyes like many other products.
This product just sits on top of my skin and pills. Definitely cant wear it under makeup.
Doesn't sink in. Sits on top of skin. Can't wear it in the morning under make up because it pills up really bad.

UMW eye power treatment by Philosophy delivers excellent results every time! Tried and true product that smooths fine lines and helps diminish signs of aging, so we can do it gracefully. Thank you Philosophy!
I haven't seen a change with this product vs the other eye treatment I was using also by philosophy
I inquired about a very good eye cream, and was sold hard on this product. I am so disappointed because for the price it does not match promised results.

avis.titre: I would not buy this again.
avis.texte: I would never buy this again. too expensive and not seeing any results on the bags under my eyes . just made them redder.
A little goes a long way. I noticed a difference after using this within a few days. I use it am/pm. Very light and not a lot of scent. No irritation. Definitely will purchase again.
Feels soft and rich enough for the delicate eye area—don't yet know how well it will work on problem areas

I really like this serum. It's a little heavy, so a little goes a long way, and doesn't seem to blend well with other products on in the same area. It does help with making my eye area brighter and has helped a bit with fine lines also!
Absolutely amazing!! Love the way this product makes my eyes look refreshed and tightens the skin making me look refreshed!!
This eye serum is great. It goes on easy and absorbs completely. My eyes look so much firmer and youthful. Great product that I highly recommend.
love this smooth eye cream, glides on, non-greasy, gentle. powerful formula that doesn't sting or irritate sensitive eye area.
I started this product a week ago. My eyes look amazing! My skin feel softer and my fine lines are virtually invisible.
my under eyes are notably smoother, firmer, and more youthful looking. I pair it with the miracle multi rejuvinating cream. It has retinoid and hylauronic acid
Love this product - it has helped calm to circles and lighten the darkness under my eyes.
Love in a bottle!! Been using for a couple weeks and it has softened my lines. Soaks in quickly. No oily residue. I will purchase again.
I LOVE this eye product! Goes on smooth and lasts through the day and night
Started seeing difference within a couple of days. After 45 days incredible.
I love this product. Has helped with crepeiness (sp) and crows feet. Very hydrating. Well worth that price

i love the applicator on this product, it makes it super easy to apply and stays clean which is important! but the actually serum is goopy and sits on my skin like a synthetic bandaid and feels gross after a few hours. not for me.
I got this serum for free I just had to give my honest opinion about it. I do like how it goes on. You will have this as your go to product. I love it and use it

I've recently started using philosophy ultimate miracle worker fix serum eye power-treatment fill & firm and couldn't be more happier with the results I've achieved thus far! It's easy to apply, just gently apply with your fingertips around the eye contour a.m. and p.m. for best results. The ingredients are and not limited to bi-retinoid, a potent form of vitamin c, sodium hyaluronate & soy extract, a formula that delivers optimal efficacy to help retexturize the feel of rough skin, fill in the appearance of hollows, tear throughs and wrinkles as well as plump, firm and redensify the look of skin. It leaves my skin feeling soft, firm and moisturized leaving my fine lines and wrinkles (crows feet) less noticeable. Overall my skin looks more smoother, healthier and more youthful! And that glow that comes with application of this serum will definitely have your friends and family asking about your skincare products and routine. Making this product ideal for any/all skin types including those with sensitive skin.

Philosophy Ultimate Miracle worker fix serum eye power treatment fill and firm is definite must for me in my skin care routine. It applies easily, absorbs quickly, does not feel heavy, greasy or sticky. I have sensitive skin and this has not caused any irritation whatsoever. I used it at night and I noticed results almost immediately. The skin around my eyes looked smooth, fuller and brighter. I have no more dark circles around my eyes. I absolutely love this product and will continue to use it daily.

This Philosophy ultimate miracle worker fix serum eve power-treatment fill & firm it's actually very delicate, no sent,￼ when I put that night before bed I will wake up with fresh looking skin. But the one thing about it it is, that it's not absorbing really well so it kind of rolls￼ on your skin If you rubbing your eye after putting on￼.

This cream seems to last forever. Maybe I'm not using enough. No matter because the dark circles under my eyes have improved! I will continue to use this serum for sure. Very pleased. Get you some today!
This eye serum went on smoothly, I love the modern pump which made it easy to control how much serum came out. Easy to apply and add to daily routine
Philosophy Ultimate Miracle worker fix serum eye power treatment fill and firm is awesome! I love this ! Made me look more youthful! Must try for anyone!

I really like this eye serum. It gives me instant result making my eye area look more plump and reduce the appearance of fine lines. It has built in applicator so you can massage your under eye area while applying the treatment . It can help to reduce any puffiness under eyes. The texture of the serum is lightweight so it absorbs very quickly. You don't have to worry that it will mess up your makeup application. It's a perfect eye treatment that you can wear during daytime as well as at night. After one month of daily use am/pm I can say that my eye area looks more firm and smooth. Overall it's very nice eye care product!
It is like a "miracle"! It plumps up the thin skin around the eye, and it makes the skin much smoother.

I've been using so many eye creams and serums and rarely see a difference in how my fine lines and wrinkles look. After using this for a week, I've noticed a big difference. I could really tell a huge difference in how my lines and wrinkles have diminished. True test, I quit using it for a week to see how my eyes look and i could see my lines come back. So, I'm definitely a fan of this.
I received this product from Miracle and from an influencer to give my true opinion. I have already tried it for a few weeks and it has worked perfectly for me, it restored firmness to my eyelids. ￼

All in all i would say this is a pretty good eye cream. It was moisturizing and had a slight firming effect. I used this twice a day, morning and night, on my under-eye and lid area. It worked well under my make-up and didn't make my eyes burn as some eye creams can. I liked it but wasn't blown away.

I received this item free for review through Influenster. I found this eye cream to be moisturizing, gentle, and it helped the skin around my eyes feel a bit less like crepe paper. However, the standout feature for me was the packaging! I love how the bottle is an airless pump which helps reduce the product's exposure to air. The pump helps me dispense the proper amount of product every time. What really surprised me was the rounded end where the product comes out; it's contoured for the eye area, allowing for application using just the packaging. I've seen products with sponge applicators, which I despise, and products that require me to use my fingers to apply, which might limit accessibility for some potential users. Great job Philosophy and Influenster!

avis.titre: A little goes a good way
avis.texte: I loved how light it was on my skin. I'm still giving it more time to give my final results,but so far I notice my fine lines are fading and the deeper lines are looking less noticeable. I think after this bottle is done I will be buying this.

I was pleasantly surprised by this product! I needed help blurring the under eye bags and wrinkles and this seems to be helping. Not only does it seem to be working, but it has a smooth, creamy texture and goes on well. As I've gotten older, it is difficult to find a product that can help with dark under eye circles and I'm happy to say this seems to be helping. I will continue to use and see if it helps even more in the long run.

This product definitely handled the crepiness taking place on my eye lids. I used WAY too much the first time or two and it got pilly. Now I use one pump, half on one eye/eyelid and half on the other. It was really improved my under eye area, but I'm most impressed with the crepiness because that was really starting to make me feel old!

I love this serum and eye treatment. The most problematic area for me is my under eye area. I have a darkness and fine lines. The area is often dry and so makeup can look Camry. This serum moisturizes that sensitive skin and I felt so much better after wearing it!
I consistently have bags under my eyes. I also have crows feet . I could definitely tell a difference using this! I love philosophy products, so I'm not at all surprised that I loved this one!

This felt amazing to put on. It was so smooth and just the right thickness to easily apply but not be so thin you feel like it would just disappear. I thought my eyes looked fresher after using a week.

avis.titre: I loved this product and will def be buying
avis.texte: I received this complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review and I absolutely love this eye cream. I notice a difference after a few weeks using twice daily that my under eyes are brighter. I will be buying and wld def recommend to a friend.
Ultimate Miracle Worker has a silky feel when applying to the area around the eyes. While i do not see a difference by using this product, I will continue to use a bit longer.

avis.titre: This thing works like a miracle
avis.texte: I am absolutely in love with this eye cream. It makes my under eye bag instantly gone and my face is just lighter. I use this everyday and cannot go without it anymore.

I am so excited to try this serum. I love philosophy products! 🥰 This one is no exception. I don't know if it's long enough to see a big difference, but I love the way this feels. You don't need very much. Just a grain sized pump and then pat around your eye area. It's very hydrating even though it's super lightweight. I would recommend this eye serum because you don't need much, it will last a long time. It feels so good. 😍 Is it a Miracle? I hope so!

I was super excited to try the ultimate miracle worker fix eye power treatment fill and firm from philosophy! The package is nice with a practical applicator that is easy to use! The formula is creamy, has no scent and is non greasy- so my skin absorbed it very quickly. I'm using it for a few weeks in my morning and night routine consistently and I'm loving the results! I feel my under eye skin is very hydrated and smooth, looking plump and firm. I have some dark circles but they are looking brighter and less noticeable. I will keep using it since it's working for me although it's a little pricey I only need a little amount of product every time so it will go a long way. Highly recommend giving this product a try for great results and a product that works just like advertised!
This serum is incredible it really made my under eyes better!! I absolutely love this stuff if you have bags under your eyes whether it's from age or lack of sleep !!this is for you

Since turning 40 I've been noticing darker circles and fine lines more than before and am always on the lookout to treat this without expensive surgery. I was gifted Philosophy's Ultimate Worker Fix Serum in exchange for my honest opinion. I have been using it for several weeks now at night and have noticed that the thin skin under my eyes is looking healthier and the fine lines seem to be disappearing. My skin feels softer and more supple and looks better overall. I've also been using it on the skin right between my eyebrows where I have a few large/deep wrinkles. It doesn't seem to be working as fast or as efficient, however the wrinkles are not as pronounced as before. With this serum a little goes a long way, I've been using a small pump (not even pushing it all the way down) and this works great for all around my eyes and in between my eyebrows. My technique for application is patting it in lightly instead of smoothing or rubbing it in. I feel like it still absorbs quickly and glides on without pulling at my skin. As far as results, it's taking a while, but I'm confident that my eyes are looking better and skin is looking younger and healthier.

I was very excited to try this I love philosophy as a brand to begin with so was very intrigued by this product, I'm 39 and straying to notice the wrinkles and lines around my eyes I'm not saying it's horrible but something that has been getting worse over the last few years so this product I tried for 4 weeks and I do really like it and can see a difference, I love the texture of this and the ease of it. I will be continuing to use it because if I can see results in 4 weeks I'm eager to see in 8 weeks.

I don't know that I would call something of this texture a serum, it's quite thick. It's easy to smooth on, absorbs well and feels slightly cool. My under eye does look nicely moisturized but I don't like the applicator. I'm sure the curved shape is intended to help with application but I found it too curved to work well. Pump out the product and tap it in with your fingers and it works well!
Packaging is lovely on the hands .. has a little weight to it ... a little goes a long way .. can be worn under makeup doesnt cake your other products noticeably firms .. light weight

I wasn't sure if I was going to like this product at first but I love it!.This serum absorbs easily into my skin. I feel like any lines around my eyes are less pronounced. I also think my eyes look brighter and more firm. I'll definitely purchase this product again.

I enjoyed testing the philosophy ultimate miracle worker fix eye serum. After using for just a couple of.days@ you could visibly see the differenceon the eyes. The crows feet and the lines were diminished. I would definitely recommendcthis product to others.

Overall it's a decent product. At the same time I didn't find myself reaching for it after using it for a week. I think the packaging was the most annoying thing about it. Philosophy products are pretty spendy and I don't have a lot of experience using their skin care, but for the price it would have been nice for them to put a little more into the packaging. The part where the product comes out of is meant for you to apply it to your eye but at the same time it's plastic and it is kind of pokey. I'm about to turn 41 and I'm lucky enough to have good genes as far as having youthful skin so my eye area isn't super thin and delicate quite yet but I still wouldn't massage this around that area. I basically ended up applying it the way that I would any kind of pump product and just put it on my finger and then my under eye area. I think if I would have liked the packaging more I might have put more effort into using it. Usually I'm not so picky on stuff like that but I found myself having to remind myself to use it. I've been wanting to love eye cream and serums in general so I've been trying to find one but I think it's a product I can't truly get into. But I am appreciative of the chance to try it out because I would have never thought to try it otherwise. I'm actually kind of bummed that I didn't like using it.

Love the texture and results it gave me. Made miracles happen. Dark circles and puffiness gone. I recommend this product to everyone dealing with dark circles and bags under their eyes. I'm very satisfied with the results.

So I have been using this for about a week and a half now i can tell such a difference in the darkness under my eyes i love the application of it as well it has a instantly cooling sensation such a wonderful product

avis.titre: Feels nice as far as moisturizing
avis.texte: After using this regularly for a month I'm not too sure that it did much more than moisturize my skin well and MAYBE brighten my undereyes slightly. I didn't see any improvement in the little wrinkles or the creases around my eyes when i smile. Not sure that I would purchase it again after using what Influenster sent me for this review. Always so grateful though!

I've been loving this ultimate miracle worker fix serum eye power treatment from philosophy! I have used it every day since receiving it and it's working great. I love the pump it has at the top, it lets you pump just the right amount that you need to use without wasting any! It's a pump top that I haven't seen used on any other serum and I really like it. I haven't had any irritation or problems since using it and my under eyes are looking great! Since adding this to my daily skin care routine I feel like my eyes have looked younger and brighter and less tired. I will definitely keep using it because I'm so happy with the results!

This eye cream absorbed easily onto my skin. I've been using this product religiously for about 3 weeks and have noticed that the lines around my eyes are less pronounced. It's a great product and I will definitely be purchasing in the future!

I have to say I had high hopes for this when I saw that it would help with the hollows, but I just don't think I've used it long enough to get that level results. I don't have horrible wrinkles / fine lines (yet), but I kind of want to use this to get around that. This does feel very emollient and almost like an eye mask... very rich. I definitely have noticed that I've lost some of the fullness in my under eye area, and I'm really hoping this will fix that overtime. I did receive this as an incentivized full size item in a #voxbox from @influenster, and thank you so much because I never would have bought this on my own, but I definitely will after this one's gone just to see if the hall is get better! 🫰

This is my first time trying a Philosophy product and I must say I love it. The eye treatment works so good. I could really tell a big difference in a short amount of time. I could tell a difference in the wrinkles and fine lines around my eyes and my skin is a lot smoother in this area. The product is not greasy which I love and doesn't have a strong scent to it. It absorbs quickly and a small amount goes along way. My eyes are brighter, moisturized and I definitely recommend this product. I love what it is doing for me.

avis.titre: This product is great to fill wrinkles in and rete
avis.texte: I gently applied with fingertips around the eye contour morning and evening . My skin looks and feels amazing and firm . Love this product and will be purchasing more!
I tried this for almost three weeks, but yet to find much difference. It looks as if it does have a slight plumping effect. But it pills whenever I try to layer makeup products on it.

I love this eye treatment my skin around the eyes looks and feels super hydrating. A little goes a long way, the formula is creamy, no scent and non greasy, my skin absorbs it quickly. I'm using it for a few weeks in my morning and night routine and I'm loving the results!

I tried to keep a regular routine with this product and use it twice a day and after 3 weeks I do notice a teeny bit of smoothing right in the corners. It's worth keeping up with this a bit longer to see how much better it gets. It does absorb in nicely (use just a little bit!).

I received this product free from Influenster and Philosophy for my honest review. I've definitely found my new miracle worker eye cream. I love everything about this product! Seriously!! I could tell that the area around my eyes were smoother, firmer, and more youthful. I love that this delicate yet powerful eye cream has retinol in it which is a main ingredient guaranteed to fight lines and wrinkles. It's a creamy texture that glides on easily and the packaging makes it easy to use. I will surely be adding this product to my daily routine.
I didn't see much difference but I also didn't use it consistently every day. I will keep trying to be more consistent and report back. It os easy to apply and no greasy feeling.

When you use it dont use a lot. When i put it under the eyes You have to gently rub it in pretty good because if not you will have this film that flakes off. When i wore it, it did work a little bit by de puffing My eyes but it didn't completely remove the puffiness would I recommend this product? Yes I just think maybe longer use of it would be very beneficial to me.

avis.titre: The most important factor is how gentle yet effect
avis.texte: After using this for a few day so far, Ive gotta say its been impressive. I love how smooth and gentle this cream is. No strong scents which is perfect for eye cream. My skin really takes in this cream so well without any greasy residue. My under eyes look less tired and smoother. All around the eye skin seems tighter and less crepiness. I will continue using this and enjoy all the benefits is this cream, Highly recommended!!!

avis.titre: It did ok for helping with fines line,  no miracle
avis.texte: This product was light and hydrating for around the eyes. I used for a couple weeks and noticed a slight difference. It wasn't dramatic but nice process that I was a little pleased with, even used on my lid area. I expected MORE but maybe you need to use longer.
Product was nice and did not leave face feeling greasy. Did not notice a big difference in skin tightness or smoothness.

This philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker Fix serum eye power-treatment fill & firm is very soothing and moisturizing. Has a nice cooling feel to it. Fills in lines and plumps up skin with moisture.
